program.section_heading: Introduction to Welding Processes Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to set up and complete SMAW, PAC, MIG, TIG, and FCAW processes.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to complete basic arc welding skills related to the shielded metal arc welding process, including welding in all positions with various electrodes.

blocks.name: Core Courses-81 hours (Credits listed are in hours)

notes: The award counts in hours: the core block heading reads 'Core Courses-81 hours (Credits listed are in hours)'. total_units is taken from this 81-hour figure, the only block in the requirements.
The requirements header prints '(Total 0)'. This conflicts with the 81 hours stated for the core courses.

The catalog prints 0 beside each course even though it says credits are listed in hours. Those zeros were not recorded as hours, so per-course hours are null. A reviewer should check the individual course hours.
Course codes are printed without a space (e.g., 'WELDB1BNC'). They match closed-list codes 'WELD B1BNC' and 'WELD B53BN'.
WELDB53AN (Shielded Metal Arc Welding) is not in the closed list and is recorded as a catalog addition.
Program Learning Outcomes 2 and 3 are printed with identical text. Both are recorded as printed; this may be a catalog error.
The requirements block is titled 'Welding Certificate of Completion NC', while the page heading is 'Introduction to Welding Processes Certificate of Completion'.
The source URL references 'summer-2022' although the catalog year is 2026-2027.
The career entry 'welding' comes from 'This program prepares students for entry-level employment in welding.'
